title: Red Berry Electrolytes
content: Designed for those who don't stop. It's the natural alternative to boost your performance without chemicals or refined sugars. A balanced blend of fresh citrus, local honey, and mineral salts that keep your muscles going. Pure energy from the earth to fuel your movement.

title: Natural Sourdough Bread (1 kg loaf)
content: Live sourdough bread made by MMNaturalmente, without chemicals or industrial yeasts. Fermentation pre-digests part of the gluten, reduces phytic acid (improving the absorption of iron, zinc, and magnesium), and provides sustained energy release. Hazlo Sano is an official point of sale.

title: Roasted Chicken Breast Steak
content:
Lean chicken protein for muscle recovery and Good Fats
+ Sourdough bread with peanut butter and fruit
+ 18-ingredient Super Bowl (Plant-based protein, light, and super nutritious. 18 ingredients for your microbiota, your second brain.

INGREDIENTS:
Walnut, almonds, cranberries, strawberry, spinach, lettuce, avocado, carrot, cucumber, jicama, tomato, onion, apple, grape, cheese, black sesame, brown rice, boiled or refried beans.
And the dressing of your choice).

Artisanal/homemade dressings:
- Dorado
- Balsamic vinaigrette,
- Ranch
